intent_summary: Readable CLI output distinguishes point episodes, pattern findings, cases, explicit rule violations, and reference readiness.

criteria.criterion: Point-anomaly episode counts and residual-pattern findings are labeled separately.
criteria.notes: Readable tests distinguish zero-episode residual shifts from a spike episode and retain the overlap warning.

criteria.criterion: Relationship cases identify entity scope, observed and expected values, declared units, and investigation questions.
criteria.notes: Conversion output identifies site=demo, observed/expected orders_per_visit, the relationship, and a collection-completeness investigation question.

criteria.criterion: Explicit numerical rules are named with their boundaries instead of appearing as statistical anomaly claims.
criteria.notes: Unit-cost output names review-above-13c and its [0, 0.13] boundary as a declared rule crossing.

criteria.criterion: Readiness status remains visible, including when it was not assessed.
criteria.notes: Readable output includes not_assessed and its supporting reasons without claiming measured alert accuracy.

verification_evidence: Primary Codex agent re-inspected declared implementation references and criterion evidence in the current session after the outcome-title and deliverable-lane refactor.
